title: The Killer Psychologist - Childhood Trauma Unveiled with Dr Dana Anderson

sentences.en: Psychologists, what if you could earn money beyond trading your time for money?
sentences.zh: 心理学家们，如果你们能赚取超越“出售时间换取金钱”以外的收入，会怎么样？

sentences.en: I'm Dr. Marianne Trent, clinical psychologist, and I've been developing passive and recurring income streams since 2019.
sentences.zh: 我是临床心理学家玛丽安·特伦特博士（Dr. Marianne Trent），自2019年以来，我一直在开发被动收入和经常性收入流。

sentences.en: I have some exciting news.
sentences.zh: 我有一个激动人心的消息。

sentences.en: Sophie Foote's One-to-Many programme is now open for enrolment.
sentences.zh: 苏菲·富特（Sophie Foote）的“一对多”项目现已开放报名。

sentences.en: It's designed to help you turn your expertise into scalable offers like courses, memberships and digital products.
sentences.zh: 它旨在帮助你将专业知识转化为可扩展的产品，如课程、会员资格和数字产品。

sentences.en: I completed the programme myself in 2022 and have since supported two cohorts of psychologists through their journeys too.
sentences.zh: 我自己在2022年完成了这个项目，此后也支持了两届心理学家学员走过他们的旅程。

sentences.en: And if you join through my affiliate link, you'll receive Sophie's bonuses plus my own exclusive support package at no extra coSt.
sentences.zh: 如果你通过我的联盟链接加入，你将获得苏菲的奖金以及我独家提供的支持套餐，无需额外付费。

sentences.en: That includes six months of WhatsApp support, four group masterminds, masterclasses, personalised guidance, a Fortnum and Mason treat, and a time-limited one-to-one coaching bonus.
sentences.zh: 其中包括六个月的WhatsApp支持、四次小组智囊团指导、大师班、个性化指导、一份福南梅森（Fortnum and Mason）礼品，以及限时的一对一教练指导福利。

sentences.en: Enrolment closes on Monday the 16th of November at 10pm.
sentences.zh: 报名将于11月16日星期一晚上10点截止。

sentences.en: Find out more via my bonus page linked in the description.
sentences.zh: 请通过简介中链接的我的福利页面了解更多信息。

sentences.en: And remember, you must purchase through my link to receive my bonuses.
sentences.zh: 请记住，你必须通过我的链接购买才能获得我的福利。

sentences.en: I'm here if you have any questions.
sentences.zh: 如果你有任何问题，我随时都在。

sentences.en: Coming up in today's episode, you are in for a treat as I talk with Dr. Dana Anderson, forensic psychologist in the USA and host of The Killer PsychologiSt.
sentences.zh: 在今天的节目中，你将大饱眼福，因为我将与美国法医心理学家、《杀手心理学家》（The Killer Psychologist）的主持人达娜·安德森博士（Dr. Dana Anderson）进行交谈。

sentences.en: It is a fascinating listen as we navigate complex trauma and what it is like to grow up in the states where there are guns everywhere.
sentences.zh: 这是一场引人入胜的对话，我们探讨了复杂的创伤，以及在美国这样一个到处都是枪支的国家长大是什么体验。

sentences.en: We look at how she rose above her personal circumstances and how she used determination, commitment and empathy to have a different outcome for her and her own children.
sentences.zh: 我们探讨了她如何超越个人环境，如何运用决心、承诺和同理心，为自己和孩子们创造了不同的人生结局。

sentences.en: It is a fascinating listen and I absolutely adored it.
sentences.zh: 这是一场引人入胜的访谈，我非常喜欢。

sentences.en: I hope you find it really useful.
sentences.zh: 希望你觉得它真的很有用。

sentences.en: Hi, welcome along to the Aspiring Psychologist podcaSt.
sentences.zh: 嗨，欢迎收听《有抱负的心理学家播客》（Aspiring Psychologist Podcast）。

sentences.en: I am Dr. Marianne Trent and I'm a qualified clinical psychologiSt.
sentences.zh: 我是玛丽安·特伦特博士，一名合格的临床心理学家。

sentences.en: I had wanted to chat with today's guest for a little while and I am so pleased that we are able to bring you this episode.
sentences.zh: 我一直想和今天的嘉宾聊聊，很高兴我们能为您带来这期节目。

sentences.en: It is just incredible.
sentences.zh: 它简直太棒了。

sentences.en: It was an absolute pleasure to speak with Dr. Dana and we just had a really wonderful connected talk where everything was slowed down, thoughtful, kind of curious.
sentences.zh: 与达娜博士交谈绝对是一大快事，我们进行了一场非常美妙、心领神会的交谈，一切都慢下来、充满深思、带着某种好奇心。

sentences.en: And I just absolutely loved what we did.
sentences.zh: 我简直太喜欢我们所做的一切了。

sentences.en: So I hope you find it really useful and I would love your feedback.
sentences.zh: 所以我希望你觉得它真的很有用，并期待你的反馈。

sentences.en: I will catch you on the other side.
sentences.zh: 我们在节目的另一端见。

sentences.en: Hi, just want to welcome along Dr. Dana Anderson.
sentences.zh: 嗨，热烈欢迎达娜·安德森博士。

sentences.en: Hi, thank you for joining us.
sentences.zh: 嗨，谢谢你加入我们。

sentences.en: Hi, I'm so excited to be here.
sentences.zh: 嗨，我很高兴能来到这里。

sentences.en: I had a wonderful time meeting you last time and I was, I'm so excited to connect with other psychologists because sometimes it feels a little lonely.
sentences.zh: 上次见到你我度过了一段美好的时光，我很高兴能与其他的心理学家建立联系，因为有时这感觉有点孤独。

sentences.en: It does, it can do.
sentences.zh: 确实如此，有时会这样。

sentences.en: And we first met on LinkedIn, didn't we?
sentences.zh: 我们最早是在领英（LinkedIn）上认识的，对吧？

sentences.en: Because you'd sent me a connection request and we were slipping into each other's voice notes.
sentences.zh: 因为你给我发送了好友请求，然后我们开始互发语音消息。

sentences.en: And then I was like, should we just get together and have a chat on camera?
sentences.zh: 接着我说，我们要不要一起在镜头前聊聊天？

sentences.en: That would be really fun.
sentences.zh: 那一定很有趣。

sentences.en: Yes, yes, I love it.
sentences.zh: 是的，是的，我很喜欢。

sentences.en: A lot can be lost through social media and I like to leave voice messages just so connotation isn't lost in text.
sentences.zh: 通过社交媒体可能会遗漏很多东西，我喜欢发语音消息，这样文字就不会丢失语调和潜台词。

sentences.en: To just say, hi, I'm happy to meet you or let's get together or something like that.
sentences.zh: 只是为了说，嗨，很高兴认识你，或者我们一起聚聚之类的话。

sentences.en: So it seems more personable.
sentences.zh: 所以这显得更有个人温度。

sentences.en: I definitely agree.
sentences.zh: 我绝对赞同。

sentences.en: And when we met for like a pre-podcast chat and that was a few weeks ago now, wasn't it?
sentences.zh: 当我们为了录播客前的聊天聚在一起时——那已经是几周前的事了吧？

sentences.en: And we just had so much fun, didn't we?
sentences.zh: 我们玩得太开心了，不是吗？

sentences.en: Yeah, maybe it's like the bonding of psychologists.
sentences.zh: 对，也许这就是心理学家之间的纽带吧。

sentences.en: We, I know what you've been through.
sentences.zh: 我们，我知道你经历过什么。

sentences.en: Like, you know, we've been through the school, the program, like we have some understanding.
sentences.zh: 就像，你知道的，我们经历过学校、项目，我们有某种共鸣。

sentences.en: And we're both entrepreneurs now.
sentences.zh: 而且我们现在都是创业者。

sentences.en: Now we've started our own business and I want to learn from others that have not only gotten their psychology degree, but now you're an entrepreneur, you're a CEO.
sentences.zh: 现在我们创办了自己的企业，我想向其他人学习，他们不仅获得了心理学学位，而且现在你是一名创业者，你是一名首席执行官（CEO）。

sentences.en: You are making it all on your own.
sentences.zh: 你完全靠自己闯出了一片天。

sentences.en: And that is something that we're not taught in school, how to run a business.
sentences.zh: 而这正是我们在学校里没有学过的内容，如何经营一家企业。

sentences.en: Absolutely.
sentences.zh: 完全正确。

sentences.en: And it's, it's, I find it really empowering and almost moves me to tears a little bit to, to hear you call me a business owner and an entrepreneur and a CEO.
sentences.zh: 而且，我觉得这真的赋予了我力量，甚至让我有点感动得热泪盈眶，听到你称呼我为企业主、创业者和首席执行官。

sentences.en: And actually, to begin with, when I first started, so I started my company in 2019, I was almost a little bit embarrassed of my little business.
sentences.zh: 事实上，一开始当我刚起步时——我是在2019年创办公司的，我几乎对我的小公司感到有点不好意思。

sentences.en: And it was, but actually along my journey, you know, we're currently speaking in, where are we?
sentences.zh: 那是……但实际上在我的旅程中，你知道，我们现在在说话，我们在哪里？

sentences.en: April, I was looking at my calendar, April, 2024.
sentences.zh: 2024年4月，我刚刚在看我的日历，2024年4月。

sentences.en: I would have failed the MMSE on that one, wouldn't I?
sentences.zh: 如果按照那个标准，我简明精神状态检查（MMSE）肯定不及格了，对吧？

sentences.en: April, 2024.
And I feel so proud.
sentences.zh: 我感到非常骄傲。

sentences.en: You know, that's been my, my development, my growth.
sentences.zh: 你知道，那是我的发展，我的成长。

sentences.en: I'm so proud to be a psychologist, but also to be a businesswoman.
sentences.zh: 我为自己是一名心理学家感到骄傲，同时也为自己是一名女商人感到骄傲。

sentences.en: You should be proud because there was a day in time when women weren't psychologists.
sentences.zh: 你应该感到骄傲，因为曾几何时，女性还不能成为心理学家。

sentences.en: They weren't accepted.
sentences.zh: 她们不被接受。

sentences.en: They weren't allowed.
sentences.zh: 她们不被允许。

sentences.en: The first woman that got her PhD, they wouldn't recognize her as being a psychologiSt.
sentences.zh: 第一个获得博士学位的女性，他们甚至不承认她是一名心理学家。

sentences.en: And I always think of that.
sentences.zh: 我总是会想起这件事。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: How would you like to be her?
sentences.zh: 换作是你，你愿意成为她吗？

sentences.en: I think she'd be proud of us now, right?
sentences.zh: 我想她现在会为我们感到骄傲，对吧？

sentences.en: So her cohort would have been able to call themselves psychologists, but she wouldn't.
sentences.zh: 所以她的同届同学可以称自己为心理学家，但她不行。

sentences.en: Or she was an individual PhD, so she wasn't able to get that title.
sentences.zh: 或者她是单独攻读博士学位，所以她无法获得那个头衔。

sentences.en: All of the men that got, I mean, historically, it was white men, you know, particularly from privileged backgrounds.
sentences.zh: 所有获得博士学位的男性——我的意思是，历史上，都是白人男性，特别是那些来自特权背景的人。

sentences.en: And they got PhDs and they were psychologists.
sentences.zh: 他们获得了博士学位，他们就是心理学家。

sentences.en: And the first woman who said, I could do this too.
sentences.zh: 而第一个站出来说“我也能做到这一点”的女性，

sentences.en: She went through the whole doctoral program and they said, good for you.
sentences.zh: 她完成了整个博士项目，而他们却对她说：“很好。”

sentences.en: Good job.
sentences.zh: “干得好。”

sentences.en: But you're still not a psychologiSt.
sentences.zh: “但你仍然不是心理学家。”

sentences.en: And she's like, rude.
sentences.zh: 而她的反应是：“太粗鲁了吧。”

sentences.en: And so, so much has changed through the years.
sentences.zh: 所以，这些年发生了太多的变化。

sentences.en: And I was raised in a very sexist upbringing.
sentences.zh: 我在一个非常大男子主义的家庭环境中长大。

sentences.en: And my dad didn't want me to get an education and went through great lengths to prevent me from getting an education.
sentences.zh: 我父亲不想让我接受教育，并费尽心思阻止我接受教育。

sentences.en: And even like mocked and made fun of me, even when I was pursuing my master's degree.
sentences.zh: 甚至在我攻读硕士学位时，他也嘲笑和戏弄我。

sentences.en: And he said it was just a waste of my time.
sentences.zh: 他说我这纯粹是在浪费时间。

sentences.en: Who did I think I was?
sentences.zh: 我以为自己是谁？

sentences.en: What was I doing?
sentences.zh: 我在搞什么鬼？

sentences.en: And I thought, what am I doing?
sentences.zh: 当时我想，我到底在干什么？

sentences.en: But then I thought, how could I go wrong to seek information?
sentences.zh: 但随后我想，寻求知识怎么能算错呢？

sentences.en: How could that be bad?
sentences.zh: 这怎么会是坏事？

sentences.en: What if I learned something I hadn't known?
sentences.zh: 如果我学到了以前不知道的东西呢？

sentences.en: What if he's wrong?
sentences.zh: 如果他是错的呢？

sentences.en: What if we're all wrong?
sentences.zh: 如果我们所有人都错了呢？

sentences.en: How about I just know more?
sentences.zh: 为什么我不索性了解更多呢？

sentences.en: And then I'll decide.
sentences.zh: 然后再做决定。

sentences.en: And then I remember he definitely didn't want me to pursue psychology.
sentences.zh: 然后我记得他绝对不想让我去学心理学。

sentences.en: None of my family did.
sentences.zh: 我的家人都不想。

sentences.en: They were very religious.
sentences.zh: 他们非常笃信宗教。

sentences.en: And I got ostracized.
sentences.zh: 我遭到了排挤。

sentences.en: They thought psychology was like the opposite of seeking God.
sentences.zh: 他们认为心理学就像是寻求上帝的对立面。

sentences.en: So, so they, I was ostracized.
sentences.zh: 所以，他们……我被排挤了。

sentences.en: So when I got my, when I got accepted into a doctorate program, I didn't tell anyone.
sentences.zh: 因此，当我被博士项目录取时，我没有告诉任何人。

sentences.en: It wasn't really for anyone.
sentences.zh: 这其实不是为了任何人。

sentences.en: It was just for myself.
sentences.zh: 这只是为了我自己。

sentences.en: It wasn't, I didn't need anyone to say, oh, cool.
sentences.zh: 我不需要任何人来说：“哦，太酷了。”

sentences.en: You got accepted.
sentences.zh: “你被录取了。”

sentences.en: It was like, I'm just doing this.
sentences.zh: 我的感觉是：我只是在做这件事。

sentences.en: So I drove and commuted and I went to school and I didn't really, I was like, I'll just figure this out on my own.
sentences.zh: 所以我开车通勤去上学，我真的……我想，我会自己把这事儿搞定。

sentences.en: It was met with such opposition.
sentences.zh: 这遭到了极大的反对。

sentences.en: But I think if you pursue something, do it for the right reasons.
sentences.zh: 但我认为如果你追求什么，就要为了正确的理由去做。

sentences.en: Like it's, it was for my own knowledge.
sentences.zh: 就像，这是为了我自己的知识。

sentences.en: My thirst for knowledge and perhaps people in my family were just not educated on psychology
sentences.zh: 我对知识的渴望，也许我家里的人只是没有受过心理学方面的教育，

sentences.en: and it, it really impacted me.
sentences.zh: 而这，这确实对我产生了影响。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: And it sounds like you've, who knows?
sentences.zh: 听起来你……谁知道呢？

sentences.en: We all need therapy, but it sounds like you've done a remarkable job of not holding that against them.
sentences.zh: 我们都需要心理治疗，但听起来你做了一件了不起的事，没有把那些记在他们账上。

sentences.en: They just didn't know.
sentences.zh: 他们只是不知道。

sentences.en: They didn't know.
sentences.zh: 他们不知道。

sentences.en: They weren't in the state to be able to know how incredibly important that would be and how empowering that would be.
sentences.zh: 他们当时的状态无法理解这会有多重要、会带来多大的力量。

sentences.en: But they clearly raised a young woman who knew her mind and was determined and focused and is gonna, you know, she's got tenacity.
sentences.zh: 但他们显然抚养了一个有主见、坚决、专注并且……你知道的，她有着顽强毅力的年轻女性。

sentences.en: She's gonna, she's gonna show up for herself and she's gonna do what she wants to do.
sentences.zh: 她会为自己挺身而出，去做她想做的事。

sentences.en: Kind of regardless of what you think, because she knows this is a good thing.
sentences.zh: 不管你怎么想，因为她知道这是一件好事。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: It's funny.
sentences.zh: 这很有趣。

sentences.en: My mom always said, it's funny.
sentences.zh: 我妈妈总是说，这很有趣。

sentences.en: She, she said, uh, that I was always standing up on the inside.
sentences.zh: 她，她说，呃，我内心其实一直在反抗。

sentences.en: I said, what?
sentences.zh: 我问：“什么？”

sentences.en: You said like when I would tell you something to do, you would do it, but you were standing up on the inside.
sentences.zh: 你说，当我叫你做什么事时，你表面上照做了，但你内心是在顶撞抗拒的。

sentences.en: So I like always had, um, this, I want to say attitude, but like, I would be, I'm always sort of questioning authority and, and questioning everything.
sentences.zh: 所以我好像一直有，嗯……这种，我想说是态度，但就像，我会，我总是有点质疑权威，质疑一切。

sentences.en: I think that can be a good thing.
sentences.zh: 我认为这可能是一件好事。

sentences.en: I'm not to be an independent thinker and to question things.
sentences.zh: 成为一个独立思考者并去质疑事物。

sentences.en: If you are going to be an entrepreneur and branch out on your own, you're, you're maybe not a rule follower, you're not the nine to five working in a prison, a state hospital
sentences.zh: 如果你想成为一名创业者并开辟自己的天地，你或许不是一个墨守成规的人，你不是那种朝九晚五在监狱、州立医院工作的人，

sentences.en: or something.
sentences.zh: 或者类似的地方。

sentences.en: You're not just a yes, sir, person.
sentences.zh: 你不仅仅是一个只会唯命是从的人。

sentences.en: There's problems in the system.
sentences.zh: 体制内存在着问题。

sentences.en: And I saw that and I said, well, I have some solutions.
sentences.zh: 我看到了这些，我说，嗯，我有一些解决方案。

sentences.en: I have some good ideas.
sentences.zh: 我有一些好主意。

sentences.en: There's also a lot of unethical things going on and I'm not just going to comply.
sentences.zh: 里面还存在着许多不道德的事情，我不会盲目顺从。

sentences.en: I'm going to, I said no.
sentences.zh: 我要……我说不。

sentences.en: And that's one of the number one things you're going to see in, I'm going to say forensic psychology, but I think anyone that's worked in corrections, criminal justice, those types
sentences.zh: 这是你在——我要说是在法医心理学中看到的头号事情之一，但我认为任何在惩教部门、刑事司法等类型机构工作过的人，

sentences.en: of settings, you're going to be exposed to things that are not right.
sentences.zh: 你都会接触到不正确的事情。

sentences.en: That's a fact.
sentences.zh: 这是一个事实。

sentences.en: And you need to question, not just be compliant or complicit.
sentences.zh: 你需要去质疑，而不是一味顺从或同流合污。

sentences.en: And so call it whistleblowing here.
sentences.zh: 所以，这就叫做吹哨（内部举报）。

sentences.en: I don't know if you have an equivalent term there or whether that's just the same across the USA and the UK, but it's, it's knowing that actually we've got policies.
sentences.zh: 我不知道你们那里有没有对应的术语，或者这在美国和英国是否完全一样，但这就是——知道实际上我们有政策。

sentences.en: We've got whistleblowing policies, knowing that if you see something that's not right, that's a danger to somebody or, you know, just unethical or not okay, that you're actually
sentences.zh: 我们有吹哨政策，知道如果你看到不对劲的事情、对某人构成危险的事情，或者，你知道的，仅仅是不道德或不可接受的事情，作为吹哨政策的一部分，你实际上是受到保护而去把这些事情提出来的。

sentences.en: protected as part of the whistleblowing policy to kind of bring that up.
sentences.zh: 困难之处在于，尽管你在理论上受到保护，但这在团队和组织环境中显然并不总是那么好过。

sentences.en: The difficult thing is, is that though you are in theory protected, it doesn't always obviously go down terrifically well in teams and organisation settings.

sentences.en: So, but sometimes we just do what we got to do.

sentences.en: And I think that's probably the difference, really.
sentences.zh: 我想这可能就是真正的区别吧。

sentences.zh: 我当时可能觉得傻，是因为其实我那个时候并不真的缺钱。

sentences.en: I was still working three days a week in the NHS, which is our health service here.
sentences.zh: 我当时还在英国国家医疗服务体系（NHS）每周工作三天，也就是我们这里的医疗服务机构。

sentences.en: And I started my business because my husband had said, well, what are you going to do when our youngest starts preschool?
sentences.zh: 我之所以开始创业，是因为我丈夫曾说过，当老幺开始上学前班时你打算怎么办？

sentences.en: Because you don't work, you know, those two mornings a week when you usually would have him.
sentences.zh: 因为你不用工作，你知道的，每周那两个上午你通常得带着他。

sentences.en: And I was thinking, I don't know, go for a facial, you know, have a nap, you know, catch up on the chaos of the last three years.
sentences.zh: 当时我在想，不知道，去整个面部护理吧，你知道的，打个盹，你知道的，补觉，顺便从过去三年的混乱中缓过神来。

sentences.en: And he was like, you could start a business.
sentences.zh: 而他却说，你可以创业啊。

sentences.en: And I was like, I suppose I could.
sentences.zh: 当时我想，我大概可以吧。

sentences.en: So that's how my business was born.
sentences.zh: 所以我的事业就是这样诞生的。

sentences.en: But I initially was so scared of spending any money, lest I not have any money to pay my taxes with.
sentences.zh: 但一开始我非常害怕花任何钱，生怕没有钱用来交税。

sentences.zh: 因为在英国，如果你受雇于人，你的税是在源头扣除的。

sentences.en: You don't need to do any of that.
sentences.zh: 你根本不需要操心这些。

sentences.zh: 而当你自谋职业时，你就得负责申报收入、计算开销以及所有这些杂七杂八的事情。

sentences.en: So I just saved, other than my costs, I needed to run my business, like room hire and indemnity and all of that.
sentences.zh: 所以我只是把钱存起来，除了开展业务所需的必要开销，比如租房费、职业责任险以及诸如此类的费用。

sentences.en: I just saved the rest of it.

sentences.en: So I think it's probably that's the difference.
sentences.zh: 所以我想这可能就是区别所在。

sentences.zh: 那时对我来说这并不是生死攸关的事情。

sentences.en: It was just a bit of self-actualization and something to do with my time.
sentences.zh: 这只是一点自我实现，也是用来打发时间的一些事。

sentences.en: And then it was only over the development of that and then actually during COVID that I really began to take myself seriously.
sentences.zh: 后来，随着业务的发展，特别是经历新冠疫情期间，我才真正开始认真对待自己。

sentences.en: And then it's almost three years to the day that I've become fully self-employed.
sentences.zh: 然后差不多刚好在三周年那天，我完全实现了自主创业。

sentences.en: And it's probably something about that that I now need the money I'm earning.
sentences.zh: 而且可能也是因为我现在需要赚取这些收入。

sentences.en: So I'm striving for it more.
sentences.zh: 所以我更加努力地去争取。

sentences.en: You know, I'm going to talk to you to see if you want to buy any of my pin cushions.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，我要跟你聊聊，看看你想不想买我的针插。

sentences.en: Because actually I need to pay my mortgage.
sentences.zh: 因为实际上我得付房贷。

sentences.en: I love it.
sentences.zh: 我太喜欢了。

sentences.en: I feel the same way about starting my business.
sentences.zh: 我刚开始创业时也是这种感觉。

sentences.en: The financial aspect and taxes was the most challenging because that's not my specialty, is not finances.
sentences.zh: 财务方面和税务是最具挑战性的，因为这不是我的专业，我不擅长财务。

sentences.en: And so I've, it's been two years for me doing my own business.
sentences.zh: 所以，我独立创业已经两年了。

sentences.en: And there's a lot I've learned and I'm continuing to learn.
sentences.zh: 我学到了很多，而且还在继续学习。

sentences.en: Things are getting better to be more organized, right?
sentences.zh: 事情正变得越来越有条理，对吧？

sentences.zh: 因为你，因为我也是，对吧，一个首席执行官。

sentences.en: So I have to do all these other things.
sentences.zh: 所以我必须做所有这些其他的事情。

sentences.en: Um, I'm working on negotiating contracts, um, with agencies, governmental and county agencies, and I am getting those.
sentences.zh: 嗯，我正在协商合同，嗯，与机构、政府和县级机构合作，而且我正在谈成这些合同。

sentences.en: And there's a lot of things you have to do to get in that position.
sentences.zh: 要达到那个位置，你必须做很多事情。

sentences.en: And I don't know, I feel like it's been a lot of hats for me.
sentences.zh: 而且我不知道，我觉得我承担了太多的角色。

sentences.en: Uh, but eventually my goal is to step back just a bit so that I can oversee the business and hire people and interns to do the work and I can oversee it.
sentences.zh: 嗯，不过我最终的目标是稍微退居幕后，这样我可以监督业务，并雇用人员和实习生来做具体工作，而我负责监督。

sentences.en: And do, I'm right now, I'm doing so many reports and a bit more than I would like to be doing.
sentences.zh: 而且，我现在正在做大量的报告，比我希望做的要多一些。

sentences.en: And I'm setting it up.
sentences.zh: 我正在为此做准备。

sentences.zh: 我下个月将迎来我的前三名实习生，我会培训他们，然后他们会开始做一些评估工作。

sentences.en: And my goal is to truly move over to be more of a CEO and do more consulting work, less report writing.
sentences.zh: 我的目标是真正转型为更纯粹的首席执行官，多做咨询工作，少写报告。

sentences.en: I'm doing some fun things now that I didn't think originally.
sentences.zh: 我现在正在做一些有趣的事情，这是最初没有想到的。

sentences.en: When, when you start out to do your own business, you're not really sure how it's going to go, right?

sentences.zh: 所以正是这种对好奇心的热爱，我需要神秘感。

sentences.zh: 我想要，我喜欢调查。

sentences.en: And so, um, there's some television shows that I'll be on this year or some other ones in the works where I get to explain things, right?
sentences.zh: 所以，嗯，今年我将参加一些电视节目，还有一些正在筹备中的节目，在节目中我可以解释一些事情，对吧？

sentences.en: From the perspective of some of these offenders.
sentences.zh: 从其中一些罪犯的角度出发。

sentences.en: And that is interesting to me because I want to challenge how people think about things, like to get into the minds of some of these people.
sentences.zh: 这对我很有吸引力，因为我想挑战人们对事物的看法，比如走入其中一些人的内心世界。

sentences.en: I like to explain that and help people understand it.

sentences.en: Not everything you know is common knowledge.
sentences.zh: 你所知道的并非都是常识。

sentences.en: And I also want to prevent people from becoming these horrific individuals.
sentences.zh: 我也想阻止人们变成这种可怕的个体。

sentences.en: I'm explaining it.
sentences.zh: 我正在解释这一点。

sentences.en: Uh, I like to explain it to parents and children.
sentences.zh: 嗯，我喜欢向家长和孩子解释。

sentences.en: And, uh, I work with, uh, adolescents and juvenile hall who've committed crimes, including murder.
sentences.zh: 而且，嗯，我和未成年人管教所里犯过罪的青少年合作，其中包括谋杀犯。

sentences.en: And so I meet with them and I think I have four right now with reports I need to write, but I can, I can make recommendations, right?
sentences.zh: 所以我去见他们，我想目前我有四个需要写报告的案例，不过我，我可以提出建议，对吧？

sentences.en: To the court about where, who, where they go, what their treatment is, where they transfer to, uh, and so that's the part I like, intervention.
sentences.zh: 向法庭建议他们去哪里，由谁负责，去哪里，接受什么治疗，转到哪里，嗯，所以这是我喜欢的部分，干预。

sentences.en: Because I do have people follow up.
sentences.zh: 因为我确实有进行后续跟进的案例。

sentences.en: I have one case right now, a tragic case, uh, a boy that was being abused in a number of ways, using drugs, having psychosis, um, got in trouble in a psychotic state, um,
sentences.zh: 我手头正有一个案例，一个悲惨的案例，嗯，一个男孩遭受了多方面的虐待，吸毒，出现精神病症状，嗯，在精神病发作状态下惹了麻烦，嗯，

sentences.en: got violent with someone.
sentences.zh: 对某人施暴了。

sentences.zh: 所以我做了一次精神健康分流评估。

sentences.en: So I assessed that he needs, uh, mental health treatment instead of going to potentially prison.
sentences.zh: 因此我评估认为他需要精神健康治疗，而不是可能去坐牢。

sentences.en: He was turning 18 and I've, over the last eight months I've kept in touch because I've written, I'll be writing my third report to the court with a status update.
sentences.zh: 他快满18岁了，在过去的八个月里我们一直保持联系，因为我写了，我将向法院提交第三份附带最新进展的报告。

sentences.en: And he's just doing wonderful, has a job, no psychosis, uh, doing so well as, and so he's so grateful.
sentences.zh: 他现在状态好极了，有工作，没有精神病症状，嗯，表现得非常好，所以他非常感激。

sentences.en: His life has changed.
sentences.zh: 他的人生改变了。

sentences.en: Like his attorney's happy.
sentences.zh: 就像他的律师也很高兴一样。

sentences.en: There's so many great stories to share like that, where you get to see it and you're like, yeah, I have a purpose in life.
sentences.zh: 有很多这样美好的故事可以分享，当你亲眼见证时，你会觉得，是的，我在生活中是有价值的。

sentences.en: Good things can happen.
sentences.zh: 美好的事情会发生。

sentences.zh: 而且它们因你而发生。

sentences.zh: 嗯。

sentences.zh: 哦，好吧，你刚才差点把我感动得流泪。

sentences.en: That's lovely.
sentences.zh: 这太感人了。

sentences.en: Like, you know, you, you're able to achieve those results for people and with people.
sentences.zh: 就像，你知道的，你，你能够为人们以及和人们一起取得这样的成果。

sentences.en: But the story is interesting when we give you the whole, well, the guys I'm working with have the whole discovery file, and audio recordings, crime scene evidence,

sentences.en: Yeah, there's people that can pay the media not to share certain information, law enforcement officers taking bribes, there's blackmail, there's a collusion,
